nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Agent guidance note for the React Native (Expo) mobile client, directing any AI agent to always consult the versioned Expo v54 documentation before writing code.

nodes.name: CLAUDE.md
nodes.summary: Claude Code context file for the frontend-client directory that defers all agent instructions to AGENTS.md via a reference directive.
nodes.languageNotes: Contains only a single @AGENTS.md reference directive, which Claude Code resolves by reading AGENTS.md instead.

nodes.name: app.json
nodes.summary: Expo application configuration for the labConnect mobile client, defining app identity, icons, splash screen, iOS/Android platform settings, biometric and location permissions, and Google OAuth client IDs.
nodes.languageNotes: Enables Expo's new architecture (newArchEnabled: true), configures expo-local-authentication for Face ID biometric login, expo-location for nearby lab discovery, and expo-secure-store for token storage. Google OAuth client IDs are placeholder values requiring replacement before production builds.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: NPM package manifest for the labConnect React Native (Expo 54) mobile client, listing all runtime dependencies including navigation, authentication, biometrics, file system, and font packages, along with Expo CLI start scripts for Android, iOS, and web targets.
nodes.languageNotes: Pins React Native to 0.81.5 with Expo ~54.0.33 and React 19.1.0. Includes expo-auth-session and expo-web-browser for OAuth flows, expo-local-authentication for biometric auth, and react-native-webview for PDF/web rendering within the app.
